capabilities.untrusted: Detection reads the build and config files and the tab shows them; the run template is not offered and nothing is written in an untrusted workspace.
config.enabled: Off: the Spring Boot satellite registers nothing.
config.activeProfiles: The Spring profiles the `Spring Boot application` template passes as `-Dspring.profiles.active`. Set from the Spring tab; kept apart from the Maven profiles.
config.bridge: `auto`: write `spring-boot.ls.java.home` (workspace scope, through the manifest) only when Spring Tools' language server has no JDK 21 or newer. `never`: do not.
cmd.pairProfiles: Pair the Spring profiles with the active Maven profiles
config.dashboard.ports: The ports the Spring tab polls for running instances (`/actuator/health` on localhost). Empty: every `server.port` the config files set, else 8080.
config.dashboard.pollMs: How often the Spring tab polls the instances, in milliseconds, in a trusted workspace.
config.runMemoryMiB: The cap a `spring-boot` step of a `batlehub-run` declares — Maven or Gradle plus the application JVM it forks — summed against `#batlehub.java.resources.budgetMiB#` before it starts.
